hero.p1: Your small groups are where much of your church’s ministry happens—but keeping track of dozens of groups shouldn’t require chasing down messages, spreadsheets, and reports.
hero.p2: ekklesiaio makes small-group reporting simple for leaders and actionable for church leadership.
hero.noSpam: No spam. One email when we launch.

problem.title: You have the groups. But do you know what’s happening in them?
problem.intro: You may have 20, 50, or 100 small groups meeting throughout your church.
problem.bLead: But getting that information back to church leadership can be difficult.
bItems: Pastors have to chase people down.
Information gets buried in messages and spreadsheets.
And even when reports arrive, reviewing them all takes time.

how.title: Simple for leaders. Powerful for church leadership.

steps.title: Leaders report
steps.body: Small-group leaders receive reminders and submit their reports through a simple workflow.

steps.title: Leadership reviews
steps.body: Pastors, elders, and administrators get a centralized view of what’s happening across their groups.

steps.title: Needs become visible
steps.body: Prayer requests, concerns, follow-ups, and other important information are easier to identify.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.body: Keep track of what needs attention so important conversations don’t get lost.

features.title: Core features
features.f1b: Manage your groups and members from one place. Add, remove, and organize groups as your church changes.
features.f2b: Make it easy for small-group leaders to submit their reports without adding another administrative burden.
features.f3b: Help leaders remember to submit their reports without pastors having to chase them down.
features.f4b: Keep the right people informed when reports, requests, or other important updates need attention.
features.f5b: Turn information from your groups into actionable follow-ups so needs don’t get lost.
features.f6b: See what’s happening across your small groups and get a clearer picture of the life of your church.

ai.intro: ekklesiaio uses AI to help pastors and administrators make sense of every small-group report—so the people behind them get the attention they need.
ai.i1b: Get the key points of each report—and of the whole week across your groups—in a few sentences.
ai.i2b: See whether a group’s reports sound encouraged, steady, or in need of care—and notice when that changes.
ai.i3b: Surface the reports, requests, and changes that may need a pastor’s attention, so nothing important gets buried.
ai.i4b: Turn what leaders share into suggested prayer requests, ready for your team to review, edit, and share.
ai.t1b: Use the AI suggestions you find helpful and ignore the rest—or turn them off entirely. ekklesiaio works just as well without them.
ai.t2b: AI only suggests. Nothing is shared or acted on until a person has reviewed it.
ai.t3b: Your church’s reports are never used to train AI models.

card.prayer: “Pray for the families in our church facing job loss—for provision, peace, and community around them.”

philosophy.p1: ekklesiaio is built to reduce the administrative work around small-group ministry—not add more of it.
philosophy.p2: When leaders spend less time chasing reports, they can spend more time caring for people, building community, and making disciples.
philosophy.mission: To help churches care for people and make disciples by giving leaders better visibility into the life of their church.
philosophy.vision: A future where every church can easily understand, support, and care for the people in its community.

who.heading: Who we are
body: ekklesiaio is operated by Luis Palacios, based in Managua, Nicaragua (“we”, “us”). This policy explains what information we collect on ekklesiaio.com while ekklesiaio is in pre-launch, and what we do with it.

Right now the site does one thing with personal information: it keeps a waitlist of people who want to hear when ekklesiaio launches. The ekklesiaio product itself will have its own privacy policy when it opens.

collect.heading: Information we collect
collect.intro: We collect only what the waitlist needs. We don’t ask for your name, your church, or anything else.
rows: To confirm your sign-up and tell you when we launch
To write to you in your language
Which form you used (top or bottom of the page)
To understand which part of the page works
To run double opt-in and honor unsubscribes
Which links you click in our emails
You click a link in an email
To learn which updates are useful. We don’t track whether you open our emails.
To limit repeated attempts and block abuse. It’s held for about 10 minutes, not stored with your sign-up.
Cloudflare Turnstile uses them to tell people from bots (see Service providers)
To see how many people visit, without identifying you (see Cookies)

use.heading: How we use it
use.intro: We use your email only to send you a confirmation email and, once you confirm, updates about ekklesiaio’s launch. We send these because you asked for them, and you can stop them at any time.
items: We never sell or rent your information, and we don’t share it with advertisers.
We don’t use your information to train AI models.
We don’t track whether you open our emails. We do count which links in our emails get clicked, to learn what’s useful.
We use IP addresses and device signals only to keep the form safe from bots and abuse.
Anonymous visit statistics help us improve the site. They don’t identify you.

providers.heading: Service providers
providers.intro: We use a few trusted companies to run the site. They process information only to provide their service to us.
rows: Hosts the website; anonymous visit statistics
Briefly holds IP addresses to limit repeated sign-up attempts
Sends our emails and counts link clicks in them
Checks that sign-ups come from people, not bots
providers.turnstile: About Cloudflare Turnstile. Our sign-up form uses Turnstile in invisible mode. Turnstile collects signals such as your IP address, browser user-agent and connection details to tell people from bots. Cloudflare’s use of this information is described in its Turnstile Privacy Addendum.

storage.heading: Where your information is stored
storage.body: Our waitlist and our service providers’ systems are located in the United States (N. Virginia). If you live elsewhere, your information is transferred to and processed in the United States. Our providers protect it with encryption in transit and at rest.

retention.heading: How long we keep it
rows: Until ekklesiaio launches and we’ve told you, or until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it
We keep only what’s needed to make sure we never email you again (your email, language and the relevant dates). Ask us and we’ll delete those too.

rights.heading: Your choices and rights
rights.intro: You’re in control of your information.
items: Unsubscribe with the link in any email we send. It takes effect right away.
See, correct or delete your information by emailing hello@ekklesiaio.com. We’ll reply within 30 days.
Withdraw your consent at any time. This doesn’t affect emails we already sent.
rights.outro: Depending on where you live, you may have more rights under local law, such as the GDPR in Europe. You can also complain to your local data protection authority. We’ll honor any of these requests wherever you live.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.intro: We use one cookie, and no advertising or tracking cookies.
rows: Remembers the language you picked (English or Spanish)
cookies.outro: Our visit statistics (Vercel Analytics) don’t use cookies and don’t identify you. Cloudflare Turnstile runs in a separate frame on the sign-up form; see its <turnstile>privacy addendum</turnstile>.

children.heading: Children
children.body: ekklesiaio is built for church staff and leaders. The waitlist is not meant for anyone under 16, and we don’t knowingly collect their information. If you think a child has signed up, contact us and we’ll delete it.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change this policy, we’ll update the effective date above. If a change affects how we use your email, we’ll tell you by email before it takes effect.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions or requests about your privacy: hello@ekklesiaio.com.
